title: Finite locally constant sheaves and finite-etale schemes
statement:
For a scheme $T$, finite locally constant sheaves of sets on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$
are equivalent to finite etale $T$-schemes. A finite abelian group action on
the sheaf corresponds to an action by finite-etale $T$-automorphisms.

proof.text: For a finite etale P over T, use the canonical uliftYoneda sheaf, whose sheaf property comes from subcanonical_smallEtaleTopology. The finite-local-model theorem supplies an etale cover, finite constant sheaf isomorphisms and IsFiniteSheaf. Each isomorphism gives IsConstant by Sheaf.isConstant_of_iso. Pair this local constancy with the supplied finiteness.

For a locally constant sheaf with finite stalks, pass the two fields of IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheafOfTypes to the descent representability theorem. Combine the two independently proved implications as the required conjunction.
